title: Sign reversal of a singleton Fourier coefficient
statement: For every natural number $n$, every real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and every coordinate $i$, the Fourier coefficient at $\{i\}$ of the function $x\mapsto f(-x)$ is the negative of the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube
